title: Calloway Homeowner Hold Length on Homesite Reservation Activation
content:
Buyers who already own a Calloway home receive a longer activation hold length when a Homesite Reservation hold is activated. The activation hold length depends on the buyer's Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage, as its record shows owner type and status.

**Schedule.** The activation hold length is the class's initial hold days plus **5** days for a buyer whose Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage shows owner type original buyer and status active; the class's initial hold days plus **2** days for a buyer whose Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage shows owner type subsequent owner and status active; and the class's initial hold days for every other buyer.

## Benefit table

| Warranty coverage owner type | Warranty coverage status | Activation hold length |
|---|---|---|
| original buyer | active | the class's initial hold days plus 5 days |
| subsequent owner | active | the class's initial hold days plus 2 days |
| original buyer | transferred or expired | the class's initial hold days |
| subsequent owner | transferred or expired | the class's initial hold days |
| no Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage on the buyer's profile | | the class's initial hold days |

## Reading the record

Both parts of the condition must hold together: the owner type and an active status. An original buyer whose coverage has been transferred to a later owner shows status transferred and does not receive the 5 days; a subsequent owner who bought a Calloway home from its first buyer and holds active coverage receives the 2 days.

## Illustration (hypothetical class with initial hold days of 10)

| Buyer | Activation hold length |
|---|---|
| active coverage, original buyer | 15 days |
| active coverage, subsequent owner | 12 days |
| no coverage | 10 days |
